systems.system: national digital ID system / National Identity Number
systems.owner: Mauritanian National Agency for Civil Registration, with UNHCR for refugees
systems.tiers: identity numbers and cards issued to Malian refugees in M'bera camp and sought for urban refugees in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou; described as a 'highly robust national digital ID system' (July 2021)

note: The passages concern identity numbers and cards for refugees as a condition of opening a bank account; nothing on registering births or deaths.
